name: proj-project-scope-statement
description: Writes a project scope statement with in-scope deliverables, named exclusions, testable acceptance criteria per deliverable, constraints and owned assumptions, and a sign-off block. Use for "run proj-project-scope-statement", "project scope statement", "write the scope", "scope statement template", "what is out of scope", "acceptance criteria for deliverables", "stop scope creep before it starts", "define scope and exclusions", part of the AI for Project Management Pack by 90n.
